children.title: Cycle 12 · Initiating Inquiry into Prime Number Distribution

detail.title: Initiating Inquiry into Prime Number Distribution
detail.summary: This cycle establishes the first research phase for the 'Prime Number Distribution' project, focusing on the Prime Number Theorem as a fundamental entry point into the distribution of primes.

detail.reason: The Prime Number Theorem provides the foundational asymptotic description of prime distribution (pi(x) ~ x/ln(x)); this search aims to gather foundational sources for synthesizing the theorem's implications.
